criticalTests.emergencyAdvice: Elevated troponin can indicate heart muscle stress or injury. Seek urgent medical attention or go to an emergency department immediately.
Severe potassium imbalance can affect heart rhythm. Requires prompt physician evaluation.
Critically low or high hemoglobin requires timely clinical assessment.
Very low platelet levels carry a risk of bleeding. Consult a doctor promptly.
Extreme glucose levels (hypoglycemia or severe hyperglycemia) require rapid medical care.
Significantly elevated creatinine points to acute kidney stress. Please see a doctor.
